scope: Consumer-paced real Node worker threads and prepared Rust Wasm graphs. Eight source/key/master buses; matching-cadence exactness, actual prepared f64 latency metadata, integer path-difference compensation, branch inserts/send FX/delay, rack pitch/Shimmer, save/reload, source cancellation and prebooked master controls. No physical listening, realtime deadline, throughput or speedup claim.
limitations: Six fixed source IDs and original source cut only; dependent FX remain on the realtime master.
Fractional absolute latency is retained; unequal fractional path differences reject rather than round.
Rack Pitch reports128 frames of adapter latency only; its native wet pitch delay remains time-varying, not compensated.
Master events are prebooked; live pool enqueue remains source-owned.
No worker-only effects in the dependent realtime master.
mixedFractionalRejection: Error: Latency compensation requires fixed integer path differences; fractional differences or changing FM quality need another alignment policy.

pool.comparisonPolicy: Primary check: exact raw sample values against the original serial graph at the selected block cadence. A separate fixed-1024-frame reference retains all cross-cadence differences, including subnormal boundary flushing and propagated mix residuals. No amplitude tolerance or DSP/golden change.
